summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC, an Irish-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026 disclosing that Steven Gold resigned as a director effective immediately on September 30, 2026. The filing attributes the departure to personal obligations and other commitments requiring increased time and attention, and the Company expressed gratitude for his service. No successor, interim appointee, board committee change, advisor, stake, price, premium, or transaction terms were disclosed. The report is incorporated by reference into numerous Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. What to watch: whether the vacancy is filled promptly, since board composition and any committee membership changes bear on governance and quorum, and whether further director turnover follows.
